setlist_extra.title: This Could Be The Last Time

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (1 review): The Jack Straw into Sugaree opening gets the show going with real promise [15]
- **Easy Answers** (1 review): Reviewer says it hit hard and drained the set's energy, which had been high up to then [8]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Reviewer found the China Cat/Rider pairing, usually a spark, disappointing in a big way [16]
- **Crazy Fingers** (1 review): Reviewer finds it slow, and its placement into Corinna mid-second set doesn't help the energy [15]
- **Corinna** (1 review): Jerry and Bob shouted the song's name to each other over their in-ear monitor system, unheard by the crowd [9]
- **The Last Time** (1 review): Reviewer considers the Last Time coming out of Space overplayed and a drag on the second set [15]
- **Days Between** (1 review): Reviewer calls it the best part of the show, good for the later years; the rest is pedestrian [11]
- **One More Saturday Night** (1 other source): This song sat on the set one tape, and its first couple of seconds are missing [1]

## Setlist highlights

- **Maggie's Farm**: cut on the recording [20]
- **Drums**: cut on the recording [20]
- **One More Saturday Night**: cut on the recording [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-06-18.Nak300-baker.keo.109217.flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 161 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1994-06-18.145949.aud.williams.bandrofcheck.flac16f**: audience recording; 19 songs; 166 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]. Said about its sound: Audience recording of excellent quality, with very little background crowd noise [18]
- **gd1994-06-18.Nak300-baker.keo.109218.flac2496**: audience recording; 20 songs; 161 min [2]
- **gd1994-06-18.141201.FOB.Schoeps.Clarke.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: source not stated; 19 songs; 169 min [4]

## Around the show

- The bowl was hot and the crowd danced hard during the first set [8]
- Attendee recalls a picture-perfect day with sunshine throughout this afternoon show, one of three nights of the run [12]
- Reviewer reads the setlist as a nod to O.J. Simpson, since the white Bronco chase was the day before [17]
- Reviewer prefers the Sugaree from 6-25-91 to this one [9]
- Attendee rates this the weakest of the three Eugene shows, though it still has highlights [12]
- Reviewer ranks this Sugaree as very good but below the 3-18-77 and 5-11-77 versions [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-06-18.Nak300-baker.keo.109217.flac1644**: taped by baker; transferred by keo; source: Master Audience Nakamachi CM300/CP4 Shotguns>Sony D-5/Dolby B Tapes:Sony Metal Select 90's Transfer by Keo: Nakamichi MR-1>Dolby B>Korg MR-1000 @ 1 Bit/5.6mHz… [1]. Also: The tape flip during Drums was left as is, separate, for patching later [1]
- **gd1994-06-18.145949.aud.williams.bandrofcheck.flac16f**: taped by Primo Williams; transferred by Charles Bandrofcheck; source: Sony D6 -> MAC > Sony TCM-TE425 (azumth adjed) -> Sound Blaster Audigy 4! > Sound Forge 5.0 > CD Wav -> flac16. [3]
- **gd1994-06-18.Nak300-baker.keo.109218.flac2496**: taped by baker; transferred by keo; source: Master Audience Nakamachi CM300/CP4 Shotguns>Sony D-5/Dolby B Tapes:Sony Metal Select 90's Transfer by Keo: Nakamichi MR-1>Dolby B>Korg MR-1000 @ 1 Bit/5.6mHz… [2]
- **gd1994-06-18.141201.FOB.Schoeps.Clarke.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe Noel; source: flac16/48kHz ; Master Dat Recording by Greg Clark: (FOB) Schoeps MK41 > Dat (Panasonic SV-255/48k); Transfer info: Dat > Panasonic SV-3700 > Tascam DA-3000 >… [4]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Worthpoint: [Grateful Dead RARE 6/17/1994 Autzen Stadium Eugene Backstage Pass - Reonegro Art | #1884706062](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-17-1994-autzen-stadium-1884706062) [21]
